payload.sample:
.TH "NPM-PROFILE" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-profile\fR - Change settings on your registry profile
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm profile enable-2fa \[lB]auth-only|auth-and-writes\[rB]
npm profile disable-2fa
npm profile get \[lB]<key>\[rB]
npm profile set <key> <value>
.fi
.RE
.P
Note: This command is unaware of workspaces.
.SS "Description"
.P
Change your profile information on the registry. Note that this command depends on the registry implementation, so third-party
